notes.title: Update 2025 05 13
notes.content:
Fixed error handling in the slime management feature to prevent critical errors that could cause the game to stop. Also made subtle adjustments to Smellyn's collision detection and slime behavior.

That's all for this update.
Thank you as always for playing! 😀🍺

notes.title: Update 2025 05 05
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused Stinky to spawn in large numbers.
I accidentally uploaded the version with debug code still in place, which was originally created to investigate Stinky-related bugs.
Sorry for the inconvenience 🙇

Thank you so much for always playing! 🙇🙇🙇

notes.title: Update 2025 05 04
notes.content:
I've strengthened the system so that save data can be recovered even if it becomes corrupted.

That's all for now. Thank you as always for playing! 😀

notes.title: Update 2025 03 16
notes.content:
A countdown to the confirmation of the score rankings has been added for rankings that are not yet finalized.

That's all for now. Thank you as always for playing! 😀

notes.title: Update 2025 03 14
notes.content:
When multiple types of liquids collide, they would sometimes scatter too violently. This issue has been addressed, so now your carefully crafted beer is less likely to spill.

That's all for now. Thank you for playing as always! 😀

notes.title: Update 2025 03 13
notes.content:
Fixed a bug caused by Stinkey.
Specifically, an issue where an error occurred when Stinkey generated beer upon contact with a slime or when pausing the game has been fixed.

That's all. Thank you for playing as always! 😀

notes.title: Update 2025 03 11
notes.content:
I fixed the issue where the NEXT slime disappearance bug persisted. Hopefully, this time it's truly resolved...!

Additionally, I've added rankings for both consecutive Brew count and total Brew count. It's perfect for those who want to take their time and carefully craft.

That's all for now. Thank you so much for playing!! 🍺

notes.title: Update 2025 03 09 2
notes.content:
Fixed (newly implemented) the method for determining rank reward claims. As a result, players who have already received their rewards will be able to claim them once more, but after that, duplicate claims will no longer be possible.

Additionally, the winning range has been expanded to the top 12 places.

That's all! Thank you for playing!! 😀

notes.title: Update 2025 03 09
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the rank reward claim status.

You should no longer be able to claim the same day's reward multiple times.

That's all! Thank you for playing a lot!! 😀

notes.title: Update 2025 03 08 2
notes.content:
I've added support for 4K fullscreen. I'm doing it without a development environment, so I'm figuring it out as I go (I've confirmed it works up to 2560x1440). I think it should work, but if it doesn't, I’m sorry. It would be helpful if you could report it again.

That’s all for this update. Thank you for playing! 😃

notes.title: Update 2025 03 08
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where sound effects would continue playing if the game was over while drinking or receiving a coin.

That’s all for this update. Thank you for playing! 😃

notes.title: Update 2025 03 07
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the NEXT slime would disappear due to interactions with other slimes, causing an error when regenerating from NEXT to the crane. Also, adjusted the UI for mouse operations when changing the score ranking type and date.

That's all! Thank you for playing!! 😀

notes.title: Update 2025 03 06 2
notes.content:
We have fixed a bug where changing the date in the score ranking caused issues.
Additionally, we fixed a bug where exploding Molton caused the Fever level to rise too much.

That’s all! Thank you for playing! 😀

notes.title: UPDATE 2025 03 06
notes.content:
We have fixed an issue where the score gain effect at high Fever levels made the game difficult to see.
Additionally, we have added support for Steam’s F12 screenshot feature.

That’s all! Thank you for playing! 😀
